property_summary: After any sequence of external calls that includes Collect, MinSum cannot be changed by a call to SetMinSum if the contract was already initialized, because SetMinSum reverts when intitalized is true. The buggy modifier misses the require(!locked_) check, so a reentrant call from Collect can execute SetMinSum and change MinSum even after initialization.

After initialization, a call to Collect cannot change MinSum because SetMinSum reverts when intitalized is true and the nonReentrant modifier prevents reentrant calls; the buggy modifier allows reentrant calls inside Collect to execute SetMinSum and change MinSum.
For any initialized contract, a single call to Collect cannot change MinSum; the buggy modifier allows reentrant calls during Collect to invoke SetMinSum and alter MinSum.
After a call to Collect, MinSum stays unchanged; the buggy modifier lacks the require(!locked_) check, allowing a reentrant call during Collect to invoke SetMinSum and alter MinSum.
SetMinSum can never succeed after Initialized is called
After Initialized is called, MinSum cannot be changed by SetMinSum because the reentrancy lock is never engaged.
After Initialized is called, SetMinSum can still succeed on the modified version, but only if called directly (non-reentrantly).
Calling SetMinSum after Initialized always fails on P, but may succeed on M.
After initialization, a successful Put call no longer prevents a subsequent SetMinSum from succeeding, because the reentrancy lock is never set to true.

For any sequence of calls where MinSum was already set (initialized), the value of MinSum must remain immutable; the buggy contract allows SetMinSum to succeed after initialization because the nonReentrant modifier never sets the lock to true.

After C is fully initialized, any external call to Collect must never change the value of MinSum; the bug allows a re-entrant call during Collect's low-level call to set MinSum via SetMinSum because the lock is never engaged.

After Initialized() is called, MinSum must remain unchanged regardless of any sequence of public calls; the bug allows MinSum to be modified via SetMinSum after initialization because the nonReentrant_ modifier never sets locked_ to true.
For any call sequence that includes Collect, MinSum must never change after initialization, but the bug lets a reentrant Collect call trigger SetMinSum because locked_ is never set to true.
After initialization, MinSum must never change during any Collect execution; the bug lets a reentrant call via Collect's low-level call invoke SetMinSum because locked_ is never set to true.
After a successful call to a nonReentrant_-protected function, a subsequent call to any such function must not revert if the reentrancy lock was properly released.
After a low-level call to collect Ether succeeds, MinSum remains unchanged regardless of the result.
A successful Collect call does not prevent a subsequent call to any nonReentrant_-protected function from executing without reverting due to the reentrancy lock.
After any successful call to a nonReentrant_-protected function, the reentrancy lock must be released, so a subsequent call to any such function must not revert due to the lock.
After a successfully completed Collect call, a subsequent call to SetMinSum must not revert.

After any sequence of calls, MinSum can be changed exactly once via SetMinSum in the reference, but in the buggy version, a prior call that triggers the modifier lock permanently prevents any subsequent call from updating MinSum, so the reference can set MinSum while the buggy version cannot.
After any successful call to Collect, a subsequent call to SetMinSum with any value always succeeds in the reference but always reverts in the buggy version.

For any successful Collect call, a subsequent call to SetMinSum(value) succeeds if and only if the contract is not permanently locked; the reference always succeeds while the buggy version always reverts.
For any successful Collect call and any subsequent MinSum update, the reference always allows SetMinSum to change MinSum, but the buggy version never updates MinSum after a Collect that completes.
